## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, plodding, and conscientious individual who possesses exceptionally unflappable nerves. Characterized by a somewhat materialistic mindset, she believes that diamonds can provide significant comfort to a person. Demonstrating a strong skill in domestic science, [Jane](../character/jane.md) is motivated to devote her entire life to teaching rather than marrying, drawn to the profession because it pays a salary.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## History

Jane Andrews joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's newly formed story club alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Ruby. She later accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), driven by her relative [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), and spent the evening discussing wealth and contentment with the other girls on their moonlight drive home. As she prepared for her own future teaching career, [Jane](../character/jane.md) debated the effectiveness and necessity of corporal punishment in maintaining classroom order during a discussion with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She also assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in visiting [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to request that he stop renting his fences for advertising, an endeavor that ultimately succeeded after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) overheard Parker accepting a bribe. Later, [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends experienced sorrow upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was resigning from her local teaching position to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) is Jane's brother. He acts as a driver for [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends, taking [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from the benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

### [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon is a local acquaintance who saved [Jane](../character/jane.md) from a dangerous fall. He caught her by her sash just as she nearly fell overboard into the lake.
